website_summary.name: 2048 Game Interface
website_summary.description: The website features a minimalist design with a grid-based layout for playing the 2048 game, displaying scores and instructions clearly.
website_summary.appearance: The website has a clean and simple design with a central game grid consisting of 16 empty tiles arranged in a 4x4 format. The background is a light gray color, and the game grid is a slightly darker shade of gray. At the top of the page, there is a header displaying the game title "2048" in bold, large font. To the right of the title, there are two rectangular buttons labeled "SCORE" and "BEST," both showing a score of "0." Below the header, there is a brief instruction line that reads "Join the tiles, get to 2048!" The overall layout is centered and occupies a moderate portion of the screen, ensuring a clear and uncluttered user interface.
website_summary.functionality: The website primarily functions as a platform for playing the 2048 game. Users can interact with the game grid by using arrow keys or swiping on touch devices to move tiles in four directions (up, down, left, right). The objective is to combine tiles with the same number to create a tile with the number 2048. The website tracks the player's current score and their best score, updating these values as the game progresses. The game automatically generates new tiles after each move, and the game ends when no more moves are possible.

functionality_testing.name: Game Board Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that pressing the right arrow key moves the tiles to the right and generates a new tile.
functionality_testing.expected_results: Tiles should move to the right, combine if possible, and a new tile should appear. The score should update accordingly.
procedure: Observe the movement of tiles and the generation of a new tile.
Verify that the score updates accordingly.

functionality_testing.name: Score Button Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the Score Button allows hovering to check real-time score updates.
functionality_testing.preconditions: Game is initialized with a score of 0.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The score should update accurately as the game progresses.
procedure: Verify that the score updates in real-time as tiles are combined.

data_display_testing.name: Verify Best Score Button Display
data_display_testing.objective: To verify that the Best Score button correctly displays the best score achieved.
data_display_testing.coverage_element: Best Score Button : Displays the best score achieved
data_display_testing.preconditions: The game has been played at least once, resulting in a non-zero best score.
data_display_testing.expected_results: The Best Score button should display the highest score ever achieved in the game.
procedure: Play the game until a new best score is achieved.
Check if the Best Score button updates to show the new best score.

design_validation_testing.name: Validate Game Grid Layout
design_validation_testing.objective: To verify that the game grid is properly laid out with 16 empty tiles in a 4x4 format.
design_validation_testing.coverage_element: Game Grid : The main playing area where tiles will appear
design_validation_testing.preconditions: The game is loaded and ready to play.
design_validation_testing.expected_results: The game grid should consist of 16 empty tiles arranged in a 4x4 format.
procedure: Count and verify the arrangement of the tiles in the game grid.

design_validation_testing.name: Check Title Display
design_validation_testing.objective: To verify that the game title '2048' is displayed correctly.
design_validation_testing.coverage_element: Title : Text displaying the game title "2048"
design_validation_testing.preconditions: The game page is fully loaded.
design_validation_testing.expected_results: The text '2048' should be displayed prominently at the top of the page in bold, large font.
procedure: Verify the presence and formatting of the game title '2048'.

element_requirement: 1. Score Button : Displays the current score
2. Best Score Button : Displays the best score achieved
3. Game Grid : The main playing area where tiles will appear
4. Title : Text displaying the game title "2048"
5. Instruction Text : Text prompting players to join tiles
